items.base: This is what's hiding under the floor of a new addition. At the bottom, the footing, with steel inside. A steel dowel bends up out of it. The first rows of block sit right over it, and those cells get filled with concrete. Inside, the soil is packed tight and treated to help keep termites away. A plastic vapor barrier goes on top. Then the slab is poured, locking into the block wall. Once it's covered, you'll never see any of this again. That's why it has to be done right the first time. Planning an addition in South Florida? Give us a call.
